I'll help you find academic papers on zero-knowledge proof systems by searching major research databases and repositories.

PLAN: Search Google Scholar for "zero-knowledge proof systems" with filters for recent years (2020-2024)
PLAN: Query arXiv.org with keywords "zero-knowledge proofs", "ZK-SNARKs", "ZK-STARKs", "zkEVM"
PLAN: Search IEEE Xplore and ACM Digital Library for conference papers from CRYPTO, EUROCRYPT, CCS, S&P
PLAN: Check Semantic Scholar for highly-cited papers on ZK-SNARKs, Bulletproofs, Plonk, Halo2
PLAN: Browse ePrint.iacr.org for latest cryptographic constructions and security proofs
PLAN: Search GitHub for "awesome-zero-knowledge-proofs" curated lists with paper references
PLAN: Check ZKProofs.org and ZKResearch.org for categorized paper collections
PLAN: Query DBLP for author profiles of key researchers (Ben-Sasson, Chiesa, Gabizon, Wuille)
